content.title: Justin Bieber Shares Sweet Hug with Son, Jack Blues, While Wife Hailey Whips Up Cinnamon Rolls to Celebrate Thanksgiving
content.text: Justin Bieber; Hailey Bieber; Jack Blues Bieber. Credit : Justin Bieber/Instagram (2) NEED TO KNOW Justin and Hailey Bieber celebrated the Thanksgiving holiday on Thursday, Nov. 27 with some family time with their 15-month-old son Jack BluesThe "Peaches" singer posted sweet snaps of himself and his boy sharing hugs against the backdrop of a beautiful sunset; the singer also shared snuggly selfies with his beauty entrepreneur wifeHailey put her cooking skills to the test over Thanksgiving, whipping up a batch of delicious-looking, frosting-topped cinnamon rolls Justin Bieber has lots to be thankful for! The “Baby” singer, 31, shared the Thanksgiving holiday with his 15-month-old son, Jack Blues and wife, Hailey, 29. While Rhode founder, Hailey, was busy baking cinnamon rolls in the kitchen, Justin shared some sweet bonding moments and plenty of hugs with Jack. The singer shared some of those father-son moments via social media with a beautiful picture of him tenderly kissing his son's head against the backdrop of a stunning sunset. Another snap, shared by Hailey via her Instagram Stories, shows Jusin and Jack sharing another hug by a pool. Justin Bieber and his son, Jack Blues. Justin Bieber/Instagram In a second carousel, also uploaded on Thursday, Nov. 27, Justin posted two snuggling selfies with his wife. He kissed her cheek in one snap while another saw the pair posing for the camera. Hailey also used the Thanksgiving holiday to get busy in the kitchen, making a delicious-looking batch of frosting-topped cinnamon rolls. Sharing the outcome of her time in the kitchen via Instagram Stories, Hailey captioned a picture of her creation, “Mommy is on cinnamon roll duty,” and later she shared a second batch she'd made. The model wrapped up her family-focused holiday celebration by enjoying one of her bakes in front of the television, calling it her “perfect evening." Hailey Bieber's cinnamon rolls. Hailey Bieber/Instagram And one person who was definitely a fan of Hailey’s efforts in the kitchen was her bestie, Kylie Jenner, 28, who also shared a shot of the bake with the caption, “oh…my…god.” It’s been a big week of celebrations for the Bieber family as Hailey marked her 29th birthday on Nov. 22, with family, friends, and the “prettiest cake.” Sharing a snippet of the festivities, the model took on Instagram Stories on Nov. 24 to share a clip of her blowing out the candles on a flower-topped white cake as her husband cheered along. Justin Bieber; Hailey Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer​​, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories. Related Stories She previously shared a series of highlights from her birthday festivities in a Nov. 23 Instagram post. The carousel included a sweet clip of Hailey and Justin holding hands as well as a photo of Jack Blues being pushed in a tricycle stroller. "Best week ringing in 29," she wrote in the caption. After dating on and off for years, Hailey and Justin got engaged in 2018. Later that same year, the couple got married in a civil ceremony in New York City. They then celebrated their marriage with a larger ceremony a year later, surrounded by over 150 family and friends. In August 2024, they welcomed their son, Jack.
